goal: Decouple the canonical Agent Kit generation worker lifetime from one MCP request and deploy that implementation with verifiable plugin package/runtime identity.
acceptance_criteria: MCP generation start returns a production run identity before Provider generation completes.
The managed worker survives normal MCP request completion and remains observable through read-only status.
A repeated start deduplicates an existing live worker.
Run-local Provider metrics remain the call-accounting authority.
The reviewed route, retry policy, sealed brief, admission, candidate, provenance, formal evidence, and resume gates remain unchanged.
A changed local plugin package cannot silently reuse a stale version-keyed cache, and status exposes safe serving identity.

quality_metrics.measure: managed generation workers terminated by normal MCP request completion
duplicate live workers for one project generation job

prevention: Assign generation completion to one managed worker instead of the MCP request
assurance: Exercise lifecycle, stale-worker, deduplication, and metrics projection without Provider calls
control: Run lifecycle, admission, provenance, formal, kernel, and MCP regressions before publication
improvement: Keep interaction-channel timeouts separate from bounded generation time

interface_expectations: cgkn_generate starts the existing canonical command and cgkn_status only observes it
The existing production-* run identity remains canonical
ProviderModelRoutingPolicy and sealed brief forwarding remain intact
Formal evidence and resume safety remain derived

feedback: Managed worker survived MCP completion and status remained responsive; strict downstream Provider schema validation blocked candidate creation.

worked: Versioned plugin installation and runtime identity exposed the serving implementation.
Managed status projected run-local metrics without starting another run.
did_not_work: The replan Provider outputs did not satisfy the unchanged strict planning schema.
experiments: Keep plugin package identity distinct from repository publication and preserve read-only run-local status as the lifecycle proof.
